title: Special Requirements for Visual Corridors
previewText: For developments within Parcels 3, 5 and 7, visual corridors shall be provided in the locations designated on Map 5 in the Appendix to this Chapter and pursuant to the requirements of Sections 62-51 (Applicability of Visual Corridor Requirements) and 62-65 (Public Access Design Reference Standards).
